items.title: Michigan judge orders Kalshi to suspend sports event contracts in state under temporary restraining order, BitRss reports
items.content_text: - **Michigan judge orders Kalshi to suspend sports event contracts in state under temporary restraining order, BitRss reports** — Ingham County Judge Rosemarie Aquilina granted emergency relief sought by Attorney General Dana Nessel, barring Kalshi from offering sports-related event contracts to Michigan residents and requiring a state-approved geolocation provider, with potential penalties up to 120,000 dollars per day. Kalshi maintains its CFTC designation governs its contracts, while Michigan says the platform lacks required gaming authorization. ([BitRss](https://bitrss.com/kalshi-forced-to-suspend-michigan-sports-betting-after-court-ruling-226729))

items.content_text: - **Orderly Predict launches 5-minute Bitcoin prediction market with fully collateralized binary shares, OurCryptoTalk reports** — Orderly Predict is a short-duration binary prediction market from Orderly Network that lets traders bet on whether Bitcoin finishes a 5-minute round higher or lower than a strike price, with each winning share paying 1 dollar and no leverage or liquidations.
